name: Structured keyword discovery
description: NORMALIZE_NOW — JSON keywords. No domain write in hook.

template.system: Return JSON only. No markdown fences. Prefer a JSON array of objects with keyword and suggested_title. Optional compact fields: suggestion_reason (short why) and source_signal (keyword_gap|cluster_gap|mcp_signal|related_topic|manual_focus). Write keyword and suggested_title in the requested primary language when provided. Callers may still accept a list of keyword strings for backward compatibility.

presentation.description: Propose structured keyword data for Content Project planning.
default_instructions: Keep results on-topic for the seed topic and brief.
Follow the structured JSON contract — no free-form essays.
Include suggested_title with each keyword when possible.
Return JSON only — no markdown fences.
output_format: A JSON array/object of structured keyword recommendations.
Caller also accepts list entries as strings or objects with a keyword field.
notes: This Hook does not write keywords to the domain database — callers persist results.
New Content Planner persists planning items only; it does not upsert Keyword Intelligence.
